title: Ballistic missile strike on Kryvyi Rih kills 2, wounds scores
detail: A Russian ballistic missile attack on Kryvyi Rih, President Zelensky's hometown, killed 2 people and wounded scores, including a child and a paramedic. Only the headline summary was available; further details are unverified.

title: Zelensky suggests new round of peace talks could take place during G-20 summit
detail: Zelensky suggested a new round of peace talks could take place on the sidelines of the G-20 summit. Only the headline summary was available; details are unverified.
